core_obligations: Choose a diagram as in the product-of-valuation-rings lemma and, since A -> B is flat, base change it to obtain the displayed cartesian square with corners B, B tensor_A K, B tensor_A V and B tensor_A L (proof lines 30734-30742).

Use that V -> B tensor_A V is weakly etale by base change of weakly etale maps, and the weak-dimension-goes-up lemma, to conclude that B tensor_A V has weak dimension at most 1 (proof lines 30743-30745).
Use that B tensor_A V -> B tensor_A L is a flat, injective epimorphism of rings, being a flat base change of such (proof lines 30746-30749).
Apply the weak-dimension-one integrated-closedness lemma to conclude that B tensor_A V is integrally closed in B tensor_A L (proof lines 30750-30751).
Use the cartesian property of the displayed square to conclude that B is integrally closed in B tensor_A K (proof lines 30752-30753).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a normal domain A with fraction field K and a weakly etale ring map A -> B, and asserts that B is integrally closed in B tensor_A K (source lines 30727-30732). The proof reduces the statement to a computable situation by choosing a diagram as in the product-of-valuation-rings lemma and base changing it along A -> B. Since A -> B is flat, the base change of that cartesian diagram gives the displayed cartesian square with corners B, B tensor_A K, B tensor_A V and B tensor_A L (proof lines 30734-30742). The substantive observations are three: that V -> B tensor_A V is weakly etale by base change of weakly etale maps, so that B tensor_A V has weak dimension at most 1 by the weak-dimension-goes-up lemma; that B tensor_A V -> B tensor_A L is a flat, injective epimorphism of rings because it is a flat base change of such; and therefore, by the weak-dimension-one integrated-closedness lemma, that B tensor_A V is integrally closed in B tensor_A L (proof lines 30743-30751). The final step transfers integrated closedness back along the cartesian square: the cartesian property of the diagram shows that B is integrally closed in B tensor_A K (proof lines 30752-30753). The non-routine content is the choice of the valuation-ring presentation of the fraction field and the transfer of integral closedness across the cartesian square.
